bibliographic-data.invention-title: TRANSKUTANE ANALYTSENSOREN, APPLIKATOREN DAFÜR UND ZUGEHÖRIGE VERFAHREN
CAPTEURS TRANSCUTANÉS D'ANALYTE, APPLICATEURS CORRESPONDANTS ET PROCÉDÉS ASSOCIÉS
TRANSCUTANEOUS ANALYTE SENSORS, APPLICATORS THEREFOR, AND ASSOCIATED METHODS

abstract.p: An applicator is provided for applying an on-skin sensor assembly to skin of a host. The applicator comprises an insertion assembly comprising an insertion member, the insertion member being configured to insert a sensor of the on-skin sensor assembly into the skin of the host; a resistance member releasably coupled to the insertion assembly; and a drive member containing an amount of stored energy. The drive member is configured to drive the insertion member in a proximal direction. The amount of stored energy is sufficient to decouple the resistance member from the insertion assembly.
